        IF ABS(rSecColdTemp_A_DegC - rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) > ABS(rSecColdTemp_B_DegC - rSecColdTemp_C_DegC) THEN

        IF ABS(rSecColdTemp_B_DegC - rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) > ABS(rSecColdTemp_C_DegC - rSecColdTemp_A_DegC) THEN
            bColdB_Healthy := FALSE;

IF bColdB_Healthy THEN iColdHealthyCount := iColdHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bColdC_Healthy THEN iColdHealthyCount := iColdHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

    (* Median Selection of 3 Healthy Channels *)
    IF ((rSecColdTemp_A_DegC >= rSecColdTemp_B_DegC) AND (rSecColdTemp_A_DegC <= rSecColdTemp_C_DegC)) OR

    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iPressHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressB_Healthy THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_A_Bar + rLoopPressure_B_Bar) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bPressA_Healthy AND bPressC_Healthy THEN
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_A_Bar + rLoopPressure_C_Bar) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rPressConsensus_Bar := (rLoopPressure_B_Bar + rLoopPressure_C_Bar) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Pressure 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Loop Pressure Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.4: HIGH-FREQUENCY ACOUSTIC EMISSION SENSOR 2oo3 TMR VOTING                 *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bAcousA_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= 140.0);
bAcousB_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= 140.0);
bAcousC_Healthy := (rAcousticNoise_C_dB >= 30.0) AND (rAcousticNoise_C_dB <= 140.0);

IF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousB_Healthy AND (ABS(rAcousticNoise_A_dB - rAcousticNoise_B_dB) > rAcousTolerance_dB) THEN
    IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rAcousticNoise_A_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) > ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) THEN
            bAcousA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bAcousB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bAcousB_Healthy AND bAcousC_Healthy AND (ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_C_dB) > rAcousTolerance_dB) THEN
    IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rAcousticNoise_B_dB - rAcousticNoise_A_dB) > ABS(rAcousticNoise_C_dB - rAcousticNoise_A_dB) THEN
            bAcousB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bAcousC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iAcousHealthyCount := 0;
IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAcousB_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN iAcousHealthyCount := iAcousHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iAcousHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= rAcousticNoise_B_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) OR
       ((rAcousticNoise_A_dB <= rAcousticNoise_B_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_A_dB >= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_A_dB;
    ELSIF ((rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= rAcousticNoise_A_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) OR
          ((rAcousticNoise_B_dB <= rAcousticNoise_A_dB) AND (rAcousticNoise_B_dB >= rAcousticNoise_C_dB)) THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_B_dB;
    ELSE
        rAcousConsensus_dB := rAcousticNoise_C_dB;
    END_IF;
    bAcous_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iAcousHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bAcous_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousB_Healthy THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB + rAcousticNoise_B_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bAcousA_Healthy AND bAcousC_Healthy THEN
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_A_dB + rAcousticNoise_C_dB) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rAcousConsensus_dB := (rAcousticNoise_B_dB + rAcousticNoise_C_dB) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Acoustic 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Acoustic Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-SECTION 2.5: IN-SODIUM ELECTROCHEMICAL HYDROGEN METERS 2oo3 TMR VOTING               *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bHydA_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= 10.0);
bHydB_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= 10.0);
bHydC_Healthy := (rHydrogenConc_C_ppm >= 0.005) AND (rHydrogenConc_C_ppm <= 10.0);

IF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydB_Healthy AND (ABS(rHydrogenConc_A_ppm - rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) > rHydTolerance_ppm) THEN
    IF bHydC_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rHydrogenConc_A_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) > ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) THEN
            bHydA_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHydB_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF bHydB_Healthy AND bHydC_Healthy AND (ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) > rHydTolerance_ppm) THEN
    IF bHydA_Healthy THEN
        IF ABS(rHydrogenConc_B_ppm - rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) > ABS(rHydrogenConc_C_ppm - rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) THEN
            bHydB_Healthy := FALSE;
        ELSE
            bHydC_Healthy := FALSE;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

iHydHealthyCount := 0;
IF bHydA_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHydB_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bHydC_Healthy THEN iHydHealthyCount := iHydHealthyCount + 1; END_IF;

IF iHydHealthyCount = 3 THEN
    IF ((rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) OR
       ((rHydrogenConc_A_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_A_ppm;
    ELSIF ((rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) OR
          ((rHydrogenConc_B_ppm <= rHydrogenConc_A_ppm) AND (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm >= rHydrogenConc_C_ppm)) THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_B_ppm;
    ELSE
        rHydConsensus_ppm := rHydrogenConc_C_ppm;
    END_IF;
    bHyd_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
ELSIF iHydHealthyCount = 2 THEN
    bHyd_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    IF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydB_Healthy THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm + rHydrogenConc_B_ppm) * 0.5;
    ELSIF bHydA_Healthy AND bHydC_Healthy THEN
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_A_ppm + rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rHydConsensus_ppm := (rHydrogenConc_B_ppm + rHydrogenConc_C_ppm) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Hydrogen 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSE
    bDegradedSensorTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Hydrogen Loss of Redundancy *)
END_IF;

(* Assemble 32-Bit Sensor Health Register *)
dwSensorHealthWord := 16#00000000;
IF bColdA_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000001; END_IF;
IF bColdB_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000002; END_IF;
IF bColdC_Healthy  THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000004; END_IF;
IF bHotA_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000008; END_IF;
IF bHotB_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000010; END_IF;
IF bHotC_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000020; END_IF;
IF bPressA_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000040; END_IF;
IF bPressB_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000080; END_IF;
IF bPressC_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000100; END_IF;
IF bAcousA_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000200; END_IF;
IF bAcousB_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000400; END_IF;
IF bAcousC_Healthy THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00000800; END_IF;
IF bHydA_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00001000; END_IF;
IF bHydB_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00002000; END_IF;
IF bHydC_Healthy   THEN dwSensorHealthWord := dwSensorHealthWord OR 16#00004000; END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: LIQUID SODIUM FINK-LEIBOWITZ THERMOPHYSICS & IHX MULTI-ZONE HEAT FLUX         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Thermophysical Properties Evaluated at Bulk Average Temperature T_bulk = (T_cold + T_hot)/2 *)
vecState_x[1] := rColdConsensus_DegC;
vecState_x[2] := rHotConsensus_DegC;
vecState_x[3] := (vecState_x[1] + vecState_x[2]) * 0.5; (* IHX Mean Temperature [deg C] *)

(* ANL/RE-95/2 Fink-Leibowitz Liquid Sodium Equations *)
rNa_Density_kg_m3 := 950.1 - 0.22976 * vecState_x[3] - 1.46E-5 * (vecState_x[3] * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_Density_kg_m3 < 780.0 THEN rNa_Density_kg_m3 := 780.0; END_IF;

rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK := 1629.0 - 0.833 * vecState_x[3] + 4.63E-4 * (vecState_x[3] * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK < 1200.0 THEN rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK := 1200.0; END_IF;

rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK := 124.7 - 0.040 * vecState_x[3];
IF rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK < 50.0 THEN rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK := 50.0; END_IF;

rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s := 0.001 * EXP(-0.55 - 0.0022 * vecState_x[3]);
IF rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s < 0.00018 THEN rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s := 0.00018; END_IF;

rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m := 1.98E7 / (1.0 + 0.0049 * (vecState_x[3] - 200.0));
IF rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m < 2.0E6 THEN rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m := 2.0E6; END_IF;

(* Hydrodynamic Velocity in IHX Core Bundle *)
IF rNa_Density_kg_m3 > 0.0 THEN
    rSodiumVelocity_m_s := vecState_x[4] / (rNa_Density_kg_m3 * 0.7850); (* 0.7850 m^2 free flow area *)
ELSE
    rSodiumVelocity_m_s := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rSodiumVelocity_m_s < 0.01 THEN rSodiumVelocity_m_s := 0.01; END_IF;

(* Dimensionless Groups: Reynolds, Prandtl, Peclet, Nusselt *)
rReynoldsNumber := (rNa_Density_kg_m3 * rSodiumVelocity_m_s * rIHX_TubeOuterDiam_m) / rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s;
IF rReynoldsNumber < 1000.0 THEN rReynoldsNumber := 1000.0; END_IF;

rPrandtlNumber := (rNa_Viscosity_Pa_s * rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK) / rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK;
IF rPrandtlNumber < 0.0020 THEN rPrandtlNumber := 0.0020; END_IF;

rPecletNumber := rReynoldsNumber * rPrandtlNumber;

(* Lyon-Martinelli Liquid Metal Correlation for Uniform Heat Flux *)
rNusseltNumber := 5.0 + 0.025 * EXP(0.8 * LN(rPecletNumber));
IF rNusseltNumber < 5.0 THEN rNusseltNumber := 5.0; END_IF;

rHeatTransferCoeff_W_m2K := (rNusseltNumber * rNa_ThermalCond_W_mK) / rIHX_TubeOuterDiam_m;

(* Multi-Zone Shell-and-Tube Thermal Resistance Modeling *)
(* Tube Wall Radial Conduction Resistance: R_wall = ln(D_o/D_i) / (2 * pi * k_steel * L) *)
rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K := 1.0 / ( (2.0 / rHeatTransferCoeff_W_m2K) + (rIHX_TubeWallThick_m / rSteel_ThermalCond_W_mK) );
IF rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K < 1000.0 THEN rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K := 1000.0; END_IF;

(* Multi-Zone Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) *)
(* Zone 1: Entrance Cross-Flow Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 := (rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - rHotConsensus_DegC);
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone1 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone1HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 0.88 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone1) * 0.001;

(* Zone 2: Active Counterflow Intermediate Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 := ((rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - rHotConsensus_DegC) + (rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC - rColdConsensus_DegC)) * 0.5;
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone2 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone2HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 1.02 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone2) * 0.001;

(* Zone 3: Exit Plenum Deceleration Region *)
rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 := (rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC - rColdConsensus_DegC);
IF rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 < 5.0 THEN rDeltaT_LM_Zone3 := 5.0; END_IF;
rIHX_Zone3HeatFlux_kW_m2 := (rOverallHeatTransU_W_m2K * 0.92 * rDeltaT_LM_Zone3) * 0.001;

(* Total Integrated IHX Thermal Power Transferred to Secondary Sodium Loop [MW] *)
rIHX_TotalHeatFlux_MW := ( (rIHX_Zone1HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone1Area_m2) +
                           (rIHX_Zone2HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone2Area_m2) +
                           (rIHX_Zone3HeatFlux_kW_m2 * rIHX_Zone3Area_m2) ) * 0.001;

(* Primary Outlet Temperature Dynamic Heat Balance *)
IF rIHX_PriFlow_kg_s > 50.0 AND rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK > 0.0 THEN
    rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC := rIHX_PriInletTemp_DegC - ((rIHX_TotalHeatFlux_MW * 1.0E6) / (rIHX_PriFlow_kg_s * rNa_SpecificHeat_J_kgK));
ELSE
    rIHX_PriOutletTemp_DegC := rColdConsensus_DegC + 10.0;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: HIGH-FREQUENCY ACOUSTIC EMISSION SWR MICRO-LEAK & HYDROGEN INTERLOCK           *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.1: Flow-Correlated Turbulent Hydraulic Baseline Acoustic Cancellation *)
(* Liquid metal pipeline turbulent noise scales with velocity to the ~2.8 power: E_bg = K_hyd * v^2.8 *)
rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 48.0 + (rAcousticHydraulicFactor * EXP(2.8 * LN(rSodiumVelocity_m_s * 10.0)));
IF rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB < 45.0 THEN rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 45.0; END_IF;
IF rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB > 95.0 THEN rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB := 95.0; END_IF;

rNetAcousticEnergy_dB := rAcousConsensus_dB - rAcousticFlowBaseline_dB;
IF rNetAcousticEnergy_dB < 0.0 THEN rNetAcousticEnergy_dB := 0.0; END_IF;

(* 4.2: Rolling Circular Buffer and 4th-Order Statistical Kurtosis Computation *)
rAcousticHistory[iAcousticBufPtr] := rAcousConsensus_dB;
iAcousticBufPtr := iAcousticBufPtr + 1;
IF iAcousticBufPtr > 16 THEN iAcousticBufPtr := 1; END_IF;

rAcousticMean_dB := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rAcousticMean_dB := rAcousticMean_dB + rAcousticHistory[iLoopCounter_i];
END_FOR;
rAcousticMean_dB := rAcousticMean_dB / 16.0;

rAcousticVariance  := 0.0;
rAcousticM4_Moment := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter_i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rMatrixMultiplyAccum := rAcousticHistory[iLoopCounter_i] - rAcousticMean_dB;
    rAcousticVariance    := rAcousticVariance + (rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum);
    rAcousticM4_Moment   := rAcousticM4_Moment + (rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum * rMatrixMultiplyAccum);
END_FOR;
rAcousticVariance  := rAcousticVariance / 16.0;
rAcousticM4_Moment := rAcousticM4_Moment / 16.0;

IF rAcousticVariance > 0.001 THEN
    rAcousticKurtosis_Stat := rAcousticM4_Moment / (rAcousticVariance * rAcousticVariance);
ELSE
    rAcousticKurtosis_Stat := 3.0; (* Standard Gaussian distribution kurtosis baseline *)
END_IF;

(* Micro-bubble acoustic threshold: Kurtosis > 4.8 OR Net Acoustic Energy > 18.0 dB *)
IF (rAcousticKurtosis_Stat > 4.8) OR (rNetAcousticEnergy_dB > 18.0) THEN
    bSWR_AcousticWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: High Acoustic Micro-Leak Pre-Alarm *)
ELSE
    bSWR_AcousticWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.3: In-Sodium Electrochemical Diffusion Hydrogen Rate-of-Rise Derivative *)
rHydrogenHistory_ppm[iHydBufPtr] := rHydConsensus_ppm;
iHydBufPtr := iHydBufPtr + 1;
IF iHydBufPtr > 8 THEN iHydBufPtr := 1; END_IF;

(* 5-Point Discrete Backward Euler Derivative: d[H]/dt [ppm/min] *)
rRawHydrogenSlope_ppm_s := (rHydConsensus_ppm - rPrevVotedHydrogen_ppm) / rCycleTime_s;
rPrevVotedHydrogen_ppm  := rHydConsensus_ppm;

(* First-order lag filtered derivative [ppm/min] *)
rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min := 0.85 * rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min + 0.15 * (rRawHydrogenSlope_ppm_s * 60.0);

(* Hydrogen Rate of Rise Excursion Threshold: > 0.015 ppm/min (Early Micro-Wastage Regime) *)
IF (rHydrogenRateOfRise_ppm_min > 0.0150) OR (rHydConsensus_ppm > 0.250) THEN
    bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: High Hydrogen Rate-of-Rise Pre-Alarm *)
ELSE
    bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* 4.4: Orthogonal Coincidence Logic: Dual Acoustic Emission AND Hydrogen Rise Confirmation *)
bSWR_CoincidenceDetected := bSWR_AcousticWarning AND bSWR_HydrogenSlopeWarning;

tSWR_ConfirmationTimer(IN := bSWR_CoincidenceDetected, PT := T#250MS);
IF tSWR_ConfirmationTimer.Q THEN
    (* SWR CONFIRMED: IMMEDIATE AUTOMATIC SAFETY ISOLATION & SECONDARY FAST DUMP *)
    bSafetyTripActive   := TRUE;
    bSWR_FastDumpActive := TRUE;
    bSystemReady        := FALSE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip    := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: SWR Micro-Leak Confirmed Trip *)
    iMachineState       := 80; (* Transition directly to Controlled Steam Generator Dump State *)
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: ALIP MAGNETOHYDRODYNAMIC (MHD) VECTOR THRUST REGULATION                       *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.1: Synchronous Traveling Magnetic Wave Velocity & Slip Calculation *)
(* v_sync = 2 * tau * f_ALIP *)
IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz > 0.1 THEN
    rSyncVelocity_m_s := 2.0 * rALIP_PolePitch_tau_m * rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz;
ELSE
    rSyncVelocity_m_s := 0.1;
END_IF;

(* Magnetic Slip Ratio: s = (v_sync - v_flow) / v_sync *)
IF rSyncVelocity_m_s > 0.001 THEN
    rALIP_SlipRatio := (rSyncVelocity_m_s - rSodiumVelocity_m_s) / rSyncVelocity_m_s;
ELSE
    rALIP_SlipRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rALIP_SlipRatio < -0.20 THEN rALIP_SlipRatio := -0.20; END_IF;
IF rALIP_SlipRatio > 1.00  THEN rALIP_SlipRatio := 1.00;  END_IF;

(* 5.2: Magnetic Reynolds Number & Longitudinal End-Effect Attenuation *)
(* Rm = mu_0 * sigma * v_sync * tau / pi *)
rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm := (rMu_0_VacuumPerm * rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m * rSyncVelocity_m_s * rALIP_PolePitch_tau_m) / rPi_Const;
IF rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm < 0.01 THEN rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm := 0.01; END_IF;

(* Longitudinal end-effect correction factor Kend(Rm) *)
rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.185 * (rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm * rMagneticReynoldsNum_Rm));
IF rEndEffectFactor_Kend > 1.0 THEN rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rEndEffectFactor_Kend < 0.2 THEN rEndEffectFactor_Kend := 0.2; END_IF;

(* Stator Bore Peak Radial Magnetic Flux Density B0 [Tesla] *)
(* Proportional to V / f ratio with iron core saturation clamp at 0.55 T *)
IF rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz > 1.0 THEN
    rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.065 * (rALIP_VoltageDemand_V / rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz);
ELSE
    rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T > 0.550 THEN rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T := 0.550; END_IF;

(* 5.3: Developed Electromagnetic Pressure Head & Vector Thrust *)
(* Delta_P_em = 0.5 * sigma * s * v_sync * B0^2 * L_active * Kend *)
rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar := ( 0.5 * rNa_ElecConductivity_S_m * rALIP_SlipRatio * rSyncVelocity_m_s *
                             (rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T * rALIP_PeakFluxDensity_B0_T) *
                             rALIP_ActiveLength_m * rEndEffectFactor_Kend ) * 1.0E-5;
IF rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar < 0.0 THEN rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Total Lorentz Axial Vector Propulsion Thrust [kN] *)
rALIP_VectorThrust_kN := (rALIP_DevelopedHead_Bar * 1.0E5 * rALIP_NominalCrossSec_m2) * 0.001;

(* ALIP Stator Thermal Winding Over-Temperature De-Rating Protection *)
(* Stator winding Class 220 limit = 200 deg C alarm, 220 deg C trip *)
IF rALIP_StatorTemp_DegC > 200.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Degraded := dwAlarmWord_Degraded OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: ALIP Stator Winding Thermal Warning *)
    (* Proportional thermal power de-rating *)
    IF rALIP_VoltageDemand_V > 280.0 THEN
        rALIP_VoltageDemand_V := 280.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rALIP_StatorTemp_DegC > 220.0 THEN
    bSafetyTripActive       := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Trip        := dwAlarmWord_Trip OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: ALIP Stator Thermal Breakdown Trip *)
    rALIP_FreqDemand_Hz     := 0.0;
    rALIP_VoltageDemand_V   := 0.0;
    iMachineState           := 70;
END_IF;
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: ASME SEC III DIV 5 / RCC-MRx THERMAL SHOCK & TRANSIENT STRAIN MITIGATION      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.1: Instantaneous Derivative of Cold Leg Temperature dT/dt *)
rColdLegTempHistory[iColdLegPtr] := rColdConsensus_DegC;
iColdLegPtr := iColdLegPtr + 1;
IF iColdLegPtr > 10 THEN iColdLegPtr := 1; END_IF;

rThermalShockRate_DegC_s := (rColdConsensus_DegC - rPrevColdConsensus_DegC) / rCycleTime_s;
rPrevColdConsensus_DegC  := rColdConsensus_DegC;
